notes.title: Snack Tick - Time Warp Update!
notes.content:
HELLO THERE!
I trust everyone is well and keeping safe!

Today I am happy to announce the first Content Update for Snack Tick, the TIME WARP UPDATE! Along with a few bugs and glitch fixes, I have added in some New Content to dive into when you next launch Snack Tick. These include the following:

The Time Aitemus!

This new Aitemus Power up will allow the player who obtains it, to slowdown time. This means the Player who is using it, will be able to collect food drops and dodge threats while everything (and everyone) surrounding them will be slowed down.

Infinity Rush Mode!

This new mode will test both your speed and reaction time! You start the mode with 15 seconds and gain an extra second for each food drop you collect. Let's see how long you can last and how much time you can give yourself.

10 New Missions!

Bringing the total up to 60, these new missions will allow players to test out the Time Aitemus with each character. This will also allow some players who are struggling to unlock characters to get them faster since these new missions will also count towards the Unlock Progress for all characters. 

Additional UI Updates!

Based on feedback, I have added visual indicators on characters for when they are recovering and using an Aitemus. Along with some fixes that related to issues that had previously appeared in the menus (gibberish text and not being able to select a button .etc)

New Achievements!

For the Completionists out there, I have added 6 New Achievements and modified some of the previous ones which were considered "tedious" by some players.

I am also happy to announce that Snack Tick will be Discounted during the Black Friday Sale next week (from 25th November 2020 to 1st December 2020), so let your friends and family know so that they can join in on the fun! It has been around 2 Months since Snack Tick has been released and I am truly grateful for all the support myself and Snack Tick have been receiving. 

Thank you again and I look forward to the next update ;-)

notes.title: Snack Tick - Version 1.05 Update! (and CONGRATS to CCA Winners!)
notes.content:
Hello there!
I hope everyone is doing well and keeping safe!

The Release of Snack Tick has really become a massive Achievement for me and I cannot thank you all enough for your Support! As I have said before, this is just the beginning:

Snack Tick has officially been on Steam for over 2 weeks now and I am grateful for all the support and feedback it has been getting. As you might already know, Snack Tick has gotten quite a few patches since launch. Most of these came after some feedback regarding certain glitches and problems that some players may have encountered. 

Glad to say the follow have been fixed:

 Fixed Issue where Missions would sometimes display both the Victory and Defeat Screens after Time Out.
 Fixed an issue where Ojiame would've been stuck on some of the stages.
 Move the Countdown Timer before a Mission starts, in front of the Mission Statement.
 Fixed an issue where the Models would display the wrong textures in the Main Menu.
 Made the "POP" more visible on the infected food.
 Added Sound option to the Pause Menu.


Along with these, the game now displays Hints and Tips during the Loading Screen and Defeat Screen for Missions. A lot of players requested this feature and I am happy to announce that it is here! Featuring simple tips, small hints and some trivia about the characters and world! I will be adding more of them within future updates. For the time being, these will be random and will change every few seconds.

Also, CONGRATS to all the Winners who played the Comic Con Africa Online Demo and Shared their High Scores! I look forward to seeing you all breaking those barriers and reaching even higher!

Thank you again and keep on hunting! ;-)
